description:
Set one property of a node in the scene at scenePath and save it. Values use Godot syntax: "Vector3(0, 1, 0)", "Color(1, 0, 0, 1)", or a resource class such as "BoxMesh". For 3 or more edits, write one summer_run_script.

value.description: Value in Summer Engine variant-string format for complex types, native JSON for primitives
